{{Quote|Heard some news I thought you might be interested in. Argel Tenn touched down a few days ago to meet with your brother.|Chet, to Darth Zannah|<ref name="DoE" />}}
'''Chet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] customs [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who worked at the primary [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Daplona]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ciutric IV]]. He commonly attended the [[Theta-class T-1 vessel|''Theta''-class T-1 vessel]] [[Victory (Theta-class T-1 vessel)|''Victory'']], the personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] of [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]&mdash;whom he knew as "Allia Omek". He also knew her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]; although he believed Bane to be "Sepp Omek", Allia's brother. Chet was later killed by Darth Zannah. He was survived by his widow.<ref name="DoE" />
